caption:
Uganda's Barter Boss #business #explore #shorts #patel #uganda #indian #relatable
my dad didn’t just build condos. he built trust into every brick.

after the 2008 crash, we lost almost everything. but instead of playing it safe, he looked 8,000 miles away… and placed a bet. first it was two plots. then two mansions. sold, flipped, leveled up.

eventually 14 units, then farmland, then a development site.but his boldest move? a 52-unit complex. with $0 in the bank.he didn’t borrow. he didn’t beg. he bartered. every vendor got the same deal:

 “build with me. i’ll give you a unit.”

no contracts. no cash flow. just faith.one person backs out, the whole thing crumbles.
